response.description: An architecture-aware diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that measures a trained recommender’s behavior and supplies those measurements, with definitions, to an interpretation prompt. It preserves the native diagnostic interface while using RecHarness macro-average validation HR@10 for model selection across all four Amazon datasets.
response.motivation: Support evidence-based model improvements while keeping diagnostics compatible with the trained architecture, available public data, and the fixed benchmark. Diagnostic observations guide hypotheses; validation HR@10 determines whether changes help.
response.implementation_notes: Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Return metrics and metric_definitions, and build the interpretation prompt from actual measurements. Probe view.model as the trained nn.Module through the compatibility methods item_emb, log2feats, and predict_score. Handle B x L sequence, positive, and negative tensors, masking padding. Adapt probes whenever the architecture changes. Use only interaction histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps; ratings, review text, commercial metadata, and simulator diversity/conformity traits are unavailable. Generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for twenty real training users, five per dataset. Preserve dataset routing, preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], and trial-local artifacts. Update the predictor writer when changing inference. No measured results are supplied, so effectiveness is unverified.
response.pseudocode:
probe = DiagnosisProbe(view, device)
raw_diagnosis = probe.run_full_diagnosis(train_loader)
assert raw_diagnosis contains metrics and metric_definitions
prompt = diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis)
hypotheses = interpret_measured_evidence(prompt)
for authorized candidate within the shared search budget:
    train candidate using the fixed data splits and seeds
    adapt probes and predictor writer to its architecture
    obtain pinned validation HR@10 for each dataset
    selection_score = mean(the four dataset HR@10 values)
select candidate by selection_score without accessing test labels

originality.positive: Connects architecture-aware diagnostics and an interpretation prompt within a controlled recommendation search workflow.
originality.negative: The description specifies an adapter contract rather than a new recommendation algorithm or novel diagnostic statistic. Score uses a 1–10 scale.

future_potential.positive: Could make iterative changes more interpretable and expose architecture-specific failures using reproducible measurements.
future_potential.negative: Benefits depend on probe quality and whether diagnostic hypotheses improve validation performance within the search budget; no supporting results are provided.

code_difficulty.positive: The fixed interface and defined batch format give a clear implementation boundary.
code_difficulty.negative: Correct masking, architecture adaptation, full-catalog recommendation, and agreement between training and generated inference require careful integration. Higher scores indicate greater difficulty.
